name: due-date-field
title: Due date field
description: A date field for tasks and deadlines: Today, Tomorrow and Next week as chips, a calendar for everything else, and No date, each said in words.
docs: value and onValueChange speak an ISO date ("2026-10-23") or null for no date. now (a Date, a timestamp or an ISO string) and timeZone say what today is: Today, Tomorrow and Next week (the coming Monday, a week away when today is a Monday) are worked out as calendar dates in that zone, so a task due tomorrow in Amsterdam is tomorrow for the server too. Without now the browser's clock is read once the page has hydrated and the server marks no quick chip, so nothing mismatches; pass now to render everything on the server. The chips are one radio group with a roving tab stop (arrow keys move and choose, Home and End jump, the chosen chip is filled with a check); Pick a date is the last dated option and opens the Calendar in a popover with its own arrow-key grid, an arrow key landing on the chip does not open it, and the focus comes back to the chip when the calendar closes. The line under the chips writes the date with its weekday and distance in the locale (Fri 23 Oct, in 3 days) and marks a date that has passed with Overdue by 2 days and an icon, and that date stays chosen and readable in the calendar; labels renames every word, and chips replaces the quick picks with { id, label, date } where date is an ISO date or a function of today's. allowPast lets the calendar offer past days, allowClear={false} removes the No date chip, weekStartsOn sets the calendar's first day, name adds a hidden input with the ISO date, and aria-labelledby or aria-label names the group.
